title: Rename the drift-check skill from reconcile-issue-map to reconcile
story: The drift-check skill is now called /reconcile instead of /reconcile-issue-map. The rename covers the skill list, dev-next's and dev-quick's end-of-run 'Drift found' line, the rules file, the README and the guide page with its graph. On the next orion update an existing project loses its old orion-installed copy and gets the new one; a project's own folder with the old name is never touched.

checks.criterion: After orion update, an install that still has the old managed copy has .claude/skills/reconcile/ and no .claude/skills/reconcile-issue-map/
checks.steps: Make an empty folder demo-project and run git init in it. Run bash orion.sh init --project demo-project --no-statusline --update-mode ask. Rename demo-project/.claude/skills/reconcile to reconcile-issue-map. Run bash orion.sh update --project demo-project --force.
checks.expected: The update output lists reconcile-issue-map (orion no longer ships it) as removed and reconcile as added; only reconcile/ is left on disk.

checks.criterion: orion update leaves alone a project's own skill folder named reconcile-issue-map with no .orion-managed marker
checks.steps: Use a fresh demo-project with init as above. Create demo-project/.claude/skills/reconcile-issue-map/SKILL.md containing 'own skill'. Run bash orion.sh update --project demo-project --force.
checks.expected: The folder and its file are unchanged, and no marker was added.

checks.criterion: dev-next's drift probe and the baseline both say 'Drift found: run /reconcile'
checks.steps: In an installed project, open .claude/skills/dev-next/SKILL.md and .claude/orion/BASE_CLAUDE.md.
checks.expected: 'Drift found: run /reconcile' appears, and /reconcile-issue-map appears nowhere.

checks.criterion: The guide page box is renamed
checks.steps: Open docs/guide/index.html in a browser and click the 'Learn · Drift' box.
